<?php
/**
 * PaymentChannel.php - Kubernetes-deployed payment channel smart contract
 * Handles bidirectional payment channels with on-chain settlement
 * Deployed via Helm chart with Redis state backend
 */

namespace App\Contracts;

use App\Blockchain\StateManager;
use App\Blockchain\CryptoUtils;
use App\Blockchain\TransactionPool;

class PaymentChannel
{
    private StateManager $state;
    private TransactionPool $txPool;
    private string $channelId;
    private int $challengePeriod = 86400; // 24 hours in seconds
    
    const CHANNEL_OPEN = 1;
    const CHANNEL_CLOSING = 2;
    const CHANNEL_CLOSED = 3;
    
    public function __construct(StateManager $state, TransactionPool $txPool)
    {
        $this->state = $state;
        $this->txPool = $txPool;
    }

    /**
     * Open a new payment channel between two parties
     */
    public function openChannel(string $sender, string $receiver, int $deposit): array
    {
        $channelId = CryptoUtils::keccak256($sender . $receiver . time());
        
        $channel = [
            'id' => $channelId,
            'sender' => $sender,
            'receiver' => $receiver,
            'deposit' => $deposit,
            'senderBalance' => $deposit,
            'receiverBalance' => 0,
            'nonce' => 0,
            'status' => self::CHANNEL_OPEN,
            'closingTimestamp' => 0,
            'lastSubmittedNonce' => 0,
        ];
        
        $this->state->set("channel:{$channelId}", $channel);
        $this->txPool->debit($sender, $deposit);
        
        return $channel;
    }

    /**
     * Submit a signed state update for off-chain payment
     * Both parties sign each state transition
     */
    public function submitStateUpdate(
        string $channelId,
        int $senderBalance,
        int $receiverBalance,
        int $nonce,
        string $senderSig,
        string $receiverSig
    ): bool {
        $channel = $this->state->get("channel:{$channelId}");
        
        if (!$channel || $channel['status'] === self::CHANNEL_CLOSED) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Channel not available');
        }

        // Verify signatures from both parties
        $message = $this->encodeState($channelId, $senderBalance, $receiverBalance, $nonce);
        
        if (!CryptoUtils::verifySignature($message, $senderSig, $channel['sender'])) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid sender signature');
        }
        
        if (!CryptoUtils::verifySignature($message, $receiverSig, $channel['receiver'])) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid receiver signature');
        }

        // Validate conservation of funds
        if ($senderBalance + $receiverBalance !== $channel['deposit']) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Balance mismatch: funds not conserved');
        }

        // Nonce must be strictly increasing
        if ($nonce <= $channel['nonce']) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Stale state update');
        }

        $channel['senderBalance'] = $senderBalance;
        $channel['receiverBalance'] = $receiverBalance;
        $channel['nonce'] = $nonce;
        
        $this->state->set("channel:{$channelId}", $channel);
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Initiate channel closure - starts challenge period
     */
    public function initiateClose(string $channelId, string $initiator): bool
    {
        $channel = $this->state->get("channel:{$channelId}");
        
        if (!$channel || $channel['status'] !== self::CHANNEL_OPEN) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Channel not open');
        }
        
        if ($initiator !== $channel['sender'] && $initiator !== $channel['receiver']) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Not a channel participant');
        }

        $channel['status'] = self::CHANNEL_CLOSING;
        $channel['closingTimestamp'] = time();
        $channel['lastSubmittedNonce'] = $channel['nonce'];
        
        $this->state->set("channel:{$channelId}", $channel);
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Challenge a closing state with a newer signed state
     * Can be called during the challenge period
     */
    public function challengeClose(
        string $channelId,
        int $senderBalance,
        int $receiverBalance,
        int $nonce,
        string $senderSig,
        string $receiverSig
    ): bool {
        $channel = $this->state->get("channel:{$channelId}");
        
        if (!$channel || $channel['status'] !== self::CHANNEL_CLOSING) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Channel not in closing state');
        }

        // Check challenge period hasn't expired
        if (time() > $channel['closingTimestamp'] + $this->challengePeriod) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Challenge period expired');
        }

        $message = $this->encodeState($channelId, $senderBalance, $receiverBalance, $nonce);
        
        if (!CryptoUtils::verifySignature($message, $senderSig, $channel['sender'])) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid sender signature');
        }
        
        if (!CryptoUtils::verifySignature($message, $receiverSig, $channel['receiver'])) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid receiver signature');
        }

        // Validate conservation of funds
        if ($senderBalance + $receiverBalance !== $channel['deposit']) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Balance mismatch');
        }

        // Challenge nonce must be higher than the closing nonce
        if ($nonce <= $channel['lastSubmittedNonce']) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Challenge state is not newer');
        }

        $channel['senderBalance'] = $senderBalance;
        $channel['receiverBalance'] = $receiverBalance;
        $channel['nonce'] = $nonce;
        $channel['lastSubmittedNonce'] = $nonce;
        
        $this->state->set("channel:{$channelId}", $channel);
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Finalize channel closure after challenge period
     * Distributes funds according to last submitted state
     */
    public function finalizeClose(string $channelId): array
    {
        $channel = $this->state->get("channel:{$channelId}");
        
        if (!$channel || $channel['status'] !== self::CHANNEL_CLOSING) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Channel not in closing state');
        }

        if (time() <= $channel['closingTimestamp'] + $this->challengePeriod) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Challenge period not yet expired');
        }

        // Distribute funds
        $this->txPool->credit($channel['sender'], $channel['senderBalance']);
        $this->txPool->credit($channel['receiver'], $channel['receiverBalance']);
        
        $channel['status'] = self::CHANNEL_CLOSED;
        $this->state->set("channel:{$channelId}", $channel);
        
        return [
            'senderPayout' => $channel['senderBalance'],
            'receiverPayout' => $channel['receiverBalance'],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Cooperative close - both parties agree to close immediately
     * Bypasses challenge period for efficiency
     */
    public function cooperativeClose(
        string $channelId,
        int $senderBalance,
        int $receiverBalance,
        string $senderSig,
        string $receiverSig
    ): array {
        $channel = $this->state->get("channel:{$channelId}");
        
        if (!$channel || $channel['status'] === self::CHANNEL_CLOSED) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Channel not available');
        }

        $message = $this->encodeCooperativeClose($channelId, $senderBalance, $receiverBalance);
        
        if (!CryptoUtils::verifySignature($message, $senderSig, $channel['sender'])) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid sender signature');
        }
        
        if (!CryptoUtils::verifySignature($message, $receiverSig, $channel['receiver'])) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid receiver signature');
        }

        // Validate balances - NOTE: uses submitted balances for conservation check
        $totalPayout = $senderBalance + $receiverBalance;
        if ($totalPayout > $channel['deposit']) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Payout exceeds deposit');
        }

        // Distribute funds
        $this->txPool->credit($channel['sender'], $senderBalance);
        $this->txPool->credit($channel['receiver'], $receiverBalance);
        
        $channel['status'] = self::CHANNEL_CLOSED;
        $channel['senderBalance'] = $senderBalance;
        $channel['receiverBalance'] = $receiverBalance;
        $this->state->set("channel:{$channelId}", $channel);
        
        return [
            'senderPayout' => $senderBalance,
            'receiverPayout' => $receiverBalance,
        ];
    }

    private function encodeState(string $channelId, int $senderBal, int $receiverBal, int $nonce): string
    {
        return CryptoUtils::keccak256(
            pack('H*a*', $channelId, pack('NNN', $senderBal, $receiverBal, $nonce))
        );
    }

    private function encodeCooperativeClose(string $channelId, int $senderBal, int $receiverBal): string
    {
        return CryptoUtils::keccak256(
            pack('H*a*', $channelId, pack('NN', $senderBal, $receiverBal))
        );
    }
}
